physical.title: Synthetic JEE-style parallel illumination through a semicircular glass section

interpretation.requestedResult: Observe native sampled parallel rays refracting at an explicitly finite flat diameter and circular arc, with independent Snell checks, TIR and passive detector readings.
assumptions: The fully specified synthetic 2D apparatus is motivated by the JEE J12 flat/curved glass geometry, but its radius, outside index, finite beam sampling and detector are teaching controls, not facts extracted from the original question.
The native Glass is a right-hand half-disk with diameter x=0, radius 100 mm and explicit inside/outside indices sqrt(2)/1.
Disabling Fresnel partial reflections omits non-TIR partial branches, but native total internal reflection remains enabled.
unknowns: The original question's absolute scale, exterior optical model and continuous incident-beam extent are not given.
Sampled crossings and native interface event counts do not establish a complete 3D half-cylinder, detected image, full ray field, irradiance or original JEE numerical answer.
